description: 新竹市自來水供水系統直接供水點(民眾端)監測數據 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新竹市環境保護局. 序號、稽查日期、稽查結果、檢驗地點、供水系統、檢驗結果-細菌項目、檢驗結果-一般項目、檢驗結果-重金屬一、依據107年新竹市飲用水管理稽查管制計畫辦理重金屬檢測，1採樣點每年檢測1次。 二、飲用水水質標準：大腸桿菌群(MPN、CFU/100mL)：6、總菌落數(CFU/mL)：100、自由有效餘氯(mg/L)：0. 2~1. 0、氫離子濃... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 新竹市環境保護局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx, csv, xml, json. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
